provider_receipt.summary: Review found correctness and evidence defects: src/policy.rs:89 checks review-trace requirements only when metadata.requires_review is true, while src/policy.rs:129 can independently make critical-risk invocations review-required; therefore a non-mutating critical tool with requires_review=false can reach review_required without the trace evidence promised by README.md:152. src/types.rs:69-89 accepts any nonblank requested_at_utc value, allowing malformed or non-UTC audit timestamps. src/policy.rs:160-168 performs raw prefix target matching without normalization, so path-like targets containing traversal components can pass an allowed prefix and later resolve outside it. Existing tests do not cover these cases. The parent receipt supports only the declared clean-tree condition and README inspection; it does not provide functional evidence sufficient to approve implementation correctness. No files were modified.
